description: Readiness Check findings brief produced by the readiness-analysis Skill (EPMCSAPAI-324), from a report parsed by tools/parse-readiness-check-export. Chapter/file provenance, findings, severity, blocker status, data gaps, caveats, confidence, and review status, per the plan's Artifact Contracts table.

title.description: e.g. "Client Name -- Readiness Check Findings Brief".

source_export.description: Filename/path of the Readiness Check export this brief was derived from.

executive_risk_summary.description: Genuine blockers or business decisions needed before the conversion can be properly scoped.

data_collection_gaps.description: Chapters/subsections that came back empty due to missing analysis -- reported as "impact unknown", never silently dropped.

supporting_number.description: The concrete figure backing the severity call, e.g. "85 company codes", "39.5-hour downtime estimate".

sad_section.description: Which SAP SAD template section this finding routes to, per the interpretation guide's mapping table.
